title: Slug Pages Query Extraction

nits.issue: Unused variable: `listingType` is destructured from `getListingBySlug` but never referenced. The page reads `listing.listingType` directly from the returned `listing` object instead.
nits.note: Not a blocker — this is dead code from an earlier approach. No runtime impact.

F-001.description: blog/[slug].astro line 63: postTags changed to post.tags
F-001.detail: getBlogPostBySlug always spreads post.tags onto the returned object (line 21 of getBlogPostBySlug.ts: tags: post.tags ? JSON.parse(...) : []). The blog slug page correctly accesses post.tags on line 63 and line 28 (structured data keywords).

F-002.description: getListingBySlug returns listingType; listings/[slug].astro uses listing.listingType
F-002.detail: getListingBySlug now (1) includes listingType in its return type, (2) queries listing_categories.parentId to derive listingType, and (3) returns listingType in ListingResult. The listings/[slug].astro page correctly reads listing.listingType directly on line 35 for schema.org @type mapping and line 88 for the display badge.

summary: Both F-001 and F-002 are correctly fixed. No new issues introduced. One nit (unused listingType destructuring) noted for cleanup but does not block PASS.
